evidence.quoted_text: exec(compile(data, str(path), "exec"), module.__dict__)  # noqa: S102 - bound bytes
evidence.reason: The current helper-loading boundary catches only OSError from read_bytes; line 82 compiles the bytes without catching SyntaxError. A readable helper with a syntax error therefore raises a raw SyntaxError instead of Refused before lock/CLI handling, and under --json the traceback goes to stderr while stdout stays empty. That violates the current contract item 2 machine-mode behavior: stderr stays empty and an error with no result writes a JSON error object to stdout. The smallest compatible fix is to translate the compile failure at this boundary while preserving the hash check and compiling only the hashed bytes.
